description:
Intent i011 (SNAPSHOT=s03, BRANCH=unchecked-tb-deref) complete. Two high-confidence findings in drivers/net/ieee802154/mac802154_hwsim.c of snapshots/s03, both in generic-netlink doit handlers of the MAC802154_HWSIM family (ops at lines 605-622 carry GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM and GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_STRICT|GENL_DONT_VALIDATE_DUMP; hwsim_genl_policy lines 579-583 types the attrs plain NLA_U32/NLA_NESTED with no required flag, so the genl core never enforces presence).

Finding 1 — hwsim_new_edge_nl (lines 421-431, MAC802154_HWSIM_CMD_NEW_EDGE): the presence guard at 421-423 joins the negated presence tests with && instead of ||, so a message that includes MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_EDGE but omits MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID passes validation with info->attrs[RADIO_ID] == NULL; line 431 'v0 = nla_get_u32(info->attrs[MAC802154_HWSIM_ATTR_RADIO_ID]);' then dereferences the NULL slot (nla_get_u32 reads through nla_data(NULL)) -> kernel NULL-deref oops. (The sibling NULL RADIO_EDGE slot fed to nla_parse_nested_deprecated at 425 is the same defect's nested-parse aspect already recorded by intents i010/i012; the uncovered nla_get_u32 at 431 is the distinct unchecked-tb-deref instance reported here.)

Finding 2 — hwsim_set_edge_lqi (lines 531-544, MAC802154_HWSIM_CMD_SET_EDGE): same inverted && guard at 531-533 leaves attrs[RADIO_ID] NULL-dereferenced by nla_get_u32 at 542 when only RADIO_EDGE is supplied; additionally, even with both outer attrs present, the inner guard at 538-540 is also &&-inverted over edge_attrs[ENDPOINT_ID] and edge_attrs[LQI], so a nested RADIO_EDGE payload containing exactly one of them passes and lines 543-544 unconditionally dereference BOTH via nla_get_u32/nla_get_u8 (e.g. nla_get_u8(NULL) when LQI is omitted) — a second, inner-level unchecked-slot dereference that no prior intent recorded.

Counterevidence: the seed-fixed sibling hwsim_del_edge_nl (lines 476-494) uses the corrected '||' guard at 483-484 and checks edge_attrs[ENDPOINT_ID] at 490 before its uses at 493-494; hwsim_del_radio_nl (187-190) and hwsim_get_radio_nl (299-301) use correct single-attribute guards.

Bounded negative evidence: 653 direct nla_get_*/nla_data/nla_len/nested-parse-on-info->attrs[] hits across net/ and drivers/ were ranked and triaged; 24 additional candidates were classified safe with concrete guard evidence (mac80211_hwsim tx_info/cloned-frame handlers, l2tp, ncsi, hsr, tcmu, seg6, gtp, nbd, nl802154, nl-phy, netlabel mgmt/cipso/calipso/unlabeled, drop_monitor, batman-adv, smc_pnet, vdpa, team, pmsr, genetlink ctrl, ila_xlat). Limitations: net/wireless/nl80211.c was spot-checked only (its doit plumbing was audited by sibling intent f010); rtnl RTM_* handlers belong to i013 and were not re-audited; no compilation or runtime reproducer was run (read-only tree), so the NULL-deref conclusion rests on guard/policy/op-flag source reading and nla_get_*/nla_parse_nested_deprecated semantics; reachability requires the mac802154_hwsim module loaded and GENL_UNS_ADMIN_PERM (satisfiable in an unprivileged user namespace); impact characterized as local DoS only. Artifact: /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C3/agent-state/findings/i011.json (snapshots_checked=["s03"], execution_status=complete, findings=2, candidates=24).
